business_summary: Shapewear, loungewear, and underwear brand featuring inclusive sizing (XXS-5X), targeting women aged 22-40 who purchase during drop releases and are not discount-driven shoppers.
fulfillment_notes: Products are sold primarily via drops.

relevant_tags.why: Core product category offered by the advertiser.
Core product category encompassing shapewear and underwear.
Broad category covering loungewear and underwear.
Primary target demographic is women aged 22-40.
Advertiser explicitly highlights inclusive sizing from XXS to 5X.
Underwear and simple loungewear are highly adjacent to daily basics.
Loungewear is a form of casual apparel.

persona_conflicts.conflict: Prefers discount-forward and clear value props; highly price-sensitive.
persona_conflicts.evidence: Don't send us people who only shop discount.

note_signals.why: Everbody features inclusive sizing across their full range, aligning perfectly with the advertiser's XXS-5X offering.
Marlowe & Co. targets older, mid-life women, whereas the advertiser's core demographic is younger women aged 22-40.
Linden Park has a conservative brand sensibility and older demographic, which conflicts with the advertiser's drop-based, youth-focused model.

gate_reason: The product categories, target demographic, and sizing parameters are clearly defined, allowing for immediate campaign planning.
clarifying_questions: What is your average order value (AOV) or typical price point for your items?
Are your products primarily one-time purchases, or do you offer any subscription options?
What is your primary campaign goal (e.g., customer acquisition, brand awareness)?
